title: THE LIFT SMALL PRINT IS READABLE
why: Seen on the 4K lift screenshot of 2026-10-08: the box saying what you take up, with the amber warning that you go up with no armour on, was 11 pixels, the smallest text on the page and the last thing read before going up; the day and weather hints beside their buttons were 11 too. The box is 15 now and the hints 14.
now: The lift page says what you take up in text you can read from the couch.
